title: Skill
description: The front matter of a skill under .ai/repo/skills/<id>/SKILL.md: identity, one-line description, lifecycle, and the optional declared inputs, outputs, tags and related skills. The body is the procedure; nothing in the front matter repeats it.

id.description: Identity; must equal the directory name. Lower-case letters, digits and hyphens.

version.description: An exact integer, raised when the procedure changes in a way a reader of an older copy should notice.

description.description: What the skill is for, in one sentence; shown by every listing.

status.description: draft is discoverable and not yet recommended; deprecated stays readable and is no longer recommended.

related.description: Ids of other skills this one hands over to or builds on; every one must exist.

inputs.description: What the worker must have before the procedure starts, one item each.

outputs.description: What the procedure leaves behind, one item each.
